lessons.title: Trigonometry

explanation_sections.title: Trigonometry
explanation_sections.body:
In a right-angled triangle, sin θ = opposite/hypotenuse, cos θ = adjacent/hypotenuse, tan θ =
opposite/adjacent.

questions.prompt: Opposite side is 6 cm and hypotenuse 10 cm. Find sin θ.
If tan θ = 3/4, state the opposite-to-adjacent ratio.
A 5 m ladder rests against a wall with its foot 3 m from the wall. How high does it reach?
Find the acute angle θ if sin θ = 0.5.
